correctness.rationale: PASS: For one inner candidate r=1-λ(2π/n)^2/2, monotonicity of support-slope bounds on each angular side makes its nearest same-radius and outer-circle neighbors decisive when outer hull contains origin (failure probability <=n2^{-(n-1)}). Independent rescaled outer gaps converge to Exp(1) and inner gaps to Exp(α); the support inequality reduces exactly in the limit to AB>λ, A(A+W)>λ, B(B+U)>λ. Conditioning on A=a,B=b yields the proposed integral profile with exp[-α((λ/a-a)_++(λ/b-b)_+)]. Two separated tagged candidates have asymptotically independent bounded-width local gaps, hence covariance→0, giving L2 convergence. Dominated convergence establishes λ and α limits including Bessel 2√λ K1, and monotonicity/squeezing gives sharp off-window transitions. Independently integrated p(1,1)=0.210403809962 and checked nearest-neighbor support criterion against actual convex hull in 12 random finite configurations.
